text:
Rajesh: Hey team — seeing tail latency spikes on eu-west hosted inference during the ~23:00-03:00 window. p95 is up >2.5s for model-g1 and model-g2. Vendor console shows 'allocated: 320' but our pool shows 240 nodes. Anyone know if extra slots were reclaimed by the vendor overnight? @Kim @Jules
Kim: I noticed an email chain from vendor-sales earlier but didn't forward. Which tenant/project is affected?
Rajesh: Tenant proj 'inference-dedicated-eu' (t-2345). Console shows multiple allocations stuck in "provisioning" for ~40m.
Jules: I'm oncall — checking vendor console now. tagging @vendor-bot for any allocation events we can surface.
vendor-bot: Allocation event: 2026-03-19T23:37:04Z — request 80 slots, provisioned 0/80, provider response: "quota_exceeded". Request ID r-88f2.
Jules: Ok, vendor returned quota_exceeded. Kim — do we have an open procurement request for extra eu-west capacity? If not we should flip to fallback.
Kim: Procurement update: vendor replied to PO-489 with "inventory constrained, ETA 7-10 days". I've opened support ticket S-1129. We can consider short-term floater to ap-south but that will add latency.
Ava: I'd avoid cross-region for these low-latency routes. Alternative: enable automatic fallback to a quantized model variant on the dedicated pool to reduce GPU footprint. Small config tweak in deploy: `fallback_policy: [quantized_v1]` plus canary route.
Rajesh: Patch makes sense. I'll prep the PR. Jules / Kim — can one of you flip the fallback after canary results?
Jules: I'll take it. Can we run a quick smoke on canary once PR is up? Ops, can you run `curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/route/test -d '{"route":"model-g1","seq":64}'` to validate?
ops-oncall: Running smoke now. Response: `{"ok":true,"p99":0.9,"p95":1.1}` — canary baseline looks fine on this run.
Kim: Finance flagged extra inter-region bandwidth cost if we move floater to ap-south. So quantized fallback preferred.
Rajesh: PR #4321 pushed (fallback + canary 10%).
Jules: Applied canary at 10% on prod routes. Monitoring. Will raise to 50% if p95 stays >1.5s or if allocations remain blocked.
vendor-bot: Ticket S-1129 update: vendor capacity refresh scheduled for 2026-03-21 — no immediate extra slots available.
Rajesh: Actions: (1) keep fallback canary at 10% and escalate to 50% if p95>1.5s; (2) Kim keep pressing S-1129 for ETA improvement; (3) Jules monitor night window and trigger vendor escalation if needed. I'll update the incident tracker.
Jules: ack :thumbsup:
Kim: ack, will follow up on S-1129 and loop vendor-sales if anything changes.
Rajesh: Thanks everyone — closing thread for now, will post a short postmortem if we hit the threshold and need rollbacks.
